1.notes: Slot 7 is set in 5% of rows (-50..999), unnamed.

3.notes: Slot 5 is 1 in 91% of rows; slot 6 of the 7-param rows is unnamed.

5.notes: Each slot holds the id of a status to cure, packed from slot 0 (1 poison, 2 blind, 3 sleep, 4 silence, 5 paralysis, 6 confusion, 7 disease, 8 petrify): 'cure sleep only' is 3,0,0,... The keys were per-status names until 2026-09-28, which misread packed lists.

6.notes: Per-ailment inflict chance %. Slot 8 is 1 in 98% of rows; that it is a duration is unconfirmed.

8.notes: Same layout as 30 MP_REGEN and the 56/57 songs.

9.notes: Slots 0/1 look like a min/max pair; slot 2 is 100. '3/4 HP' is 75: removes 75% of current HP.

10.notes: Layout matches 25 DRAIN (x, y, 100); the chance_pct name on slot 1 is doubtful (values up to 3000).

13.notes: Physical damage turn_delay turns later (1 = 'next turn', 2 = 'in two turns'), computed when it lands, with the skill's attack type (4, the wiki's 'fixed attack', on 21 rows). modifier is a percent even at 12000 (Dynamite Arrow 203140: 'fixed attack with physical damage (120x)', the wiki). area copies the targetRange (1 one enemy, 2 all) and is not read. effect_id is a visual effect id, not a skill; the effect's attackFrames group times the delayed hit.

20.notes: min grows toward max with consecutive use; damage_taken is the DEF drop ('Reduce own DEF next turn'). 90 is the magic counterpart.

21.notes: Despite the name this is DEF piercing ('partial unmitigated damage'): ignore_def -50 ignores 50% of DEF. The sign is negative here and positive in 70.

22.notes: tribe_id uses the race ids of 92. Race ids: 1 beast, 2 avian, 3 aquatic, 4 demon, 5 human, 6 machina, 7 dragon, 8 fairy, 9 insect, 10 stone, 11 plant, 12 reaper.

23.notes: tribe_id uses the race ids of 92.

24.notes: turn_count is 0 in 27% of rows (1172 of them monster skills); what 0 means is unconfirmed.

28.notes: 'Potions used affect all allies' for the listed items.

29.notes: Each choice is [skill_id, weight %] ('Dance', 'Use random ability on enemy'). Ids resolve to abilities, monster skills and, in 54 cases, passives.

33.notes: Negative values are imperils. Slot 8 is 1 in 99% of rows.

34.notes: amount = how many of the listed ailments are rolled.

38.notes: 'Chance of restoring HP for all allies' (chance 50) and 'Restore HP' (100).

44.notes: 'Enable black magic to be used twice in one turn'. The param is 'none'.

46.notes: 'Level 5 Death', 'Level 4 Graviga': affects units whose level is a multiple of level_multiple. Slot 1 (2027, 2028, 2035) is not a monster skill id.

52.notes: Leaves the field and lands on its own at the start of the turn delay_min turns later, as the unit's action for that turn; 134 is the variant the player lands. delay_min equals delay_max in every row. Every jump row has five params; the 3, 4 and 6-param rows are magic multicast commands (see variants).

variants.notes: All 13 rows are single-effect 0 MP abilities 'Enable (black/white) magic to be used N times in one turn' (Dual White Magic 502090, Chainspell 507693). magic_type as in 97: 0 any, 1 black, 2 white, 3 green.
All 10 rows are magic multicast commands like the 3-param ones, with a trailing 0.
One row, Dual White/Green Magic 504180 '2,3,2,2,504180,504180': 'Enable white or green magic to be used twice in one turn', read as two magic types.

53.notes: amount = casts per turn; slot 1 is a generated ability id; skill_id_array lists the abilities that can be multicast. Two-param rows are HIDE (see variants).

variants.notes: All 25 two-param rows are 'escape from battle for N turns'. Roy's Hide is 3,5; 'Escape from battle for one turn' is 1,1.

54.notes: amount = hits evaded. Slot 2 (437 rows) is 1 in 5% of them, unnamed.

59.notes: Slot 0 is none/0/1/2; which side's effects it removes is unconfirmed.

71.notes: Items (139 rows) and abilities (17) that cast another ability.

72.notes: Magic damage that powers up with consecutive use (magic counterpart of 126, one slot shorter). Checked against the wiki's Blood Pulsar 910225 (0,0,250,100,100,4 = 3.5x base, 1x per stack, 3 stacks): the wiki's base is modifier + modifier_increment, its stack modifier modifier_increment_2, its stack count max_stacks - 1 (the data counts the initial cast). modifier_increment_2 equals modifier_increment on every player skill and differs on 24 monster rows (Firaja 0,0,0,210,230,3). 15 rows have a physical attack type; 13 of them say magic damage.

74.notes: Monster 'Doom' (1 row), read by analogy with 1001.

79.notes: Esper attacks of Titan, Odin and Ifrit (Gaia's Wrath, Gungnir, Hellfire, ...). Eight params like 1; the physical reading follows that layout.

80.notes: Esper attacks of Shiva, Ramuh, Leviathan, Bahamut and others (Diamond Dust, Judgment Bolt, Tsunami, Megaflare, ...). Seven params like 15.

82.notes: 'Cast black magic on random enemy' (1 row); same [skill_id, weight %] pairs as 29.

83.notes: Name unconfirmed (and misspelled). 'Convert' (param 1) reduces own HP to 1 and fully restores MP.

87.notes: Monster 'Call Allies' and scripted lines; message is a MST_MONSTERSKILL_PARAM_MSG key or literal text. Slot 1 (0-25) may be a formation slot (hypothesis).

90.notes: Magic counterpart of 20 ('Boost MAG for next attack and power up with consecutive use'), same min/max/damage_taken layout.

92.notes: Each race slot is [race_id, pct] or -1. Race ids: 1 beast, 2 avian, 3 aquatic, 4 demon, 5 human, 6 machina, 7 dragon, 8 fairy, 9 insect, 10 stone, 11 plant, 12 reaper.

94.notes: Odin's Zantetsuken: 'Instantly KO or damage all enemies'. Layout like 112.

95.notes: Imbue: adds the flagged elements to physical attacks.

96.notes: phys_mag: 1 physical (191 rows), 2 magic (108), 0 both (32); missing in two Grandshelt Shield rows described as physical. The status goes on the effect's target, who covers (an ally with Illusion - Redirect, an enemy with Any Last Words?). all_allies 1 in 331 rows; 0 in two, 'guard one male ally' (with condition 2) and the monster's Bunny Block: a single-target cover of any ally. condition 2 = male allies only (a reading from that one row; passive 8 uses 1 for female).

97.notes: magic_type 0 any, 1 black, 2 white. turn_count counts the cast turn (3 = 'for two turns').

98.notes: 'Enable specific abilities to be used N times in one turn'. skill_id is a generated multicast ability. turn_count counts the cast turn (3 = 'for two turns').

99.notes: The skill becomes `true` if the caster used one of the `condition` skills last turn, otherwise `false` (the user's rule, 2026-10-05; 'Savage Blade: power up after using fast blade'). Each *_type is the skill type of the ids after it, as in 100's skill_types: 2 ability (767 condition entries, every true and false), 1 magic (8 condition entries, e.g. Blood Rend 910223 after Flare 20350).

100.notes: 'Enable X, Y for N turns' on the effect's targets (13 monster skills grant to the party). skill_types has one entry per id: 2 ability, 1 magic (checked against the ids). uses: 1 or 2 are uses; 0 (7 rows, none mentions uses) and 999 and up are unlimited. turn_count counts the cast turn (2 = 'for one turn', 4 = 'for three turns'); -1, 9999 and 99999 have no time limit. The turn_count 1 rows are cast by counters (passives 49, 50), battle-start and turn-start casts (56, 10002) and delayed casts (132), never by the player's own action. Slot 4 (1, or 0 on 15 rows) and slot 5 (a small number or a skill id; maybe a grant key) are not read.

102.notes: Three-param rows are [100, max, modifier] like 103. Six-param rows are multicast (see variants).

variants.notes: All 494 six-param rows are 'Enable specific abilities to be used N times in one turn'; same layout as 168.

112.notes: Slot 3 (-50) is DEF piercing, as in 21.

115.notes: Monster-only 'Anti Weapon Activation'. pct 100 with turn_count 999 or 9999 reads as physical immunity; compare 18.

118.notes: 'Temporarily take physical and magic damage for one selected unit'. The caster covers the selected ally. Mitigation min/max as in 96; chance is 100 in every row. physical_only is 1 in two rows, Cover (Galuf) and the JP Hiding Bear ('takes physical attacks for one ally'), 0 in the 17 described as physical and magic (a reading). Slot 4 is 1 in every row.

119.notes: A timed chance to counter physical attacks with the normal attack (on the caster). Avoid 218520 '20,1,550,2,1,0' enhances to 914053 '50,1,1000,...': 'Boosts chance of countering (to 50%)', 'Boosts damage amount of counter attack (to 1000%)', so modifier is the counter's damage in percent of the attack. turn_count 99999 (the rows passive 56 casts) lasts the battle. max is read as counters per turn (5 x10, 0 x6, 3 x3; 0 = no cap). Slot 1 (1 in 23 of 27 rows) and slot 4 (mostly 1) are unknown and not read.

123.notes: 'Add chance of counterattacking when an ally receives a physical attack' (variants: 'allies other than self', 'another ally'): the bearer counters attacks on its allies, not on itself. Same layout as 119 PHYS_COUNTER (Antagonize 216120 '50,1,150,5,1'); max 1 x15, 2 x7, 3 x6.

124.notes: 'Consume evocation gauge to damage'. stat_ratio is the [MAG, SPR] weighting (100:0, 50:50, 0:100). modifier_2 is set in 31% of rows.

126.notes: Physical damage that powers up with consecutive use (Agent Olive's Scattering Shot). Same reading as 72: the wiki's base is modifier + modifier_increment, its stack modifier modifier_increment_2 (equal to modifier_increment in every row), its stack count max_stacks - 1. Slot 0 is 1 (3 on one row).

130.notes: Wraps the ability in skill_id (3330 of 3332 resolve). cooldown = [turns, initial]: 'One use every N turns' is turns N-1 (all 811 rows of 4:4 say every 5 turns). initial equals turns or is 0; 0 presumably means not ready on turn 1. Use limits come from 1014 in the same skill.

131.notes: 'Deal fixed damage every turn to all enemies while singing' (1 row; damage_type 3 = fixed, as in 139).

132.notes: Casts the ability in skill_id (all 617 resolve) turn_delay turns after the turn of the cast: 1 = 'next turn'; 'three turns after the beginning of battle' is 3 on a battle-start cast. chance_pct is 100 in every row. key (absent in the 41 five-param rows) names the pending cast: the parent's id, the cast's id, a chain root's id or a small per-unit number, distinct within a parent; a new cast with a pending cast's key replaces it (the user's rule). Slot 1 (1 on every single-ally child and most renamed children, likely a display flag) and slot 4 (leans towards attacking children) are not read; nor the 7th param of 509591 and 512230.

133.notes: 'Remove ATK, DEF, MAG, and SPR reductions from one ally and place them on self'. Slots 4-7 are unnamed (compare 111's STOP/CHARM).

134.notes: 'Leap into the air, then attack one enemy next turn when activated': like 52, but the player lands it (LAND) from the turn delay_min turns later. delay_min equals delay_max in every row. A sixth param on 10 rows (Retribution, Warp-strike) is an animation path of x|y|z|pct waypoints, not read.

136.notes: 'Boost damage of certain abilities'. skill_ids resolve to abilities and magic. opcode_filter (rare: 124, 70) limits the boost to effects with those opcodes. stack_id is not a skill id in most rows; presumably a non-stacking group.

139.notes: 'Deal gradual damage'. damage_type is 1, 3 or 4; 3 is fixed damage per turn ('Dissonant Sonata'). stack_id is often the skill's own id.

140.notes: 'Reduce resistance to poison, blind, ...' (ability) and monster skills named 'Resistance to <ailment> has been ...'. Values are 1 or -100 per ailment; what they scale is unconfirmed. Same layout as 7.

141.notes: 'Remove ATK boosts' is 1; 1&2&3&4 removes ATK/DEF/MAG/SPR boosts; 9..16 remove elemental resistance boosts. Ids 17-36 are unmapped.

146.notes: Monster-only ('Deranging Fear'); ailments is an 8-value list of percentages.

148.notes: 'Cure zombie' and 'Cure poison ... stone, and zombie'. ailments is an 8-value flag list.

149.notes: elements = pct per element (fire, ice, lightning, water, wind, earth, light, dark). Most skills carry it twice, with slot 0 = 0 and 1, for 'boost X damage of LB, abilities, and magic'; what the flag selects is unconfirmed.

153.notes: 'Reduce physical damage dealt by fairies'. Race slots are [race_id, pct] as in 92.

157.notes: Wraps the ability in skill_id (all 579 resolve). uses matches '(N uses per battle)'; slot 3 always equals slot 2.

159.notes: 'Boost damage to break gauge for this ability when equipped with a katana'. weapon_types as in 163 (1 dagger, 2 sword, 3 large sword, 4 katana, 7 bow).

160.notes: 'Activate area effect'. No table in ffbe-data.db holds the field ids (100000002..900000040), so the field effects themselves are unknown.

162.notes: Positive values boost and negative values reduce the accuracy of physical attacks.

163.notes: 'Reduce resistance to staves'. weapon_types are equipment categories (seen: 2 sword, 4 katana, 5 staff, 6 rod, 10 spear) and may be a list.

168.notes: Same layout as the six-param form of 102 plus three slots; skill_types values are 1, 2, 3, 5. turn_count counts the cast turn (3 = 'for two turns').

169.notes: 'Consume remaining MP to deal magic damage'. Slot 1 (10-250) may scale with MP spent; unconfirmed, so nothing is named.

170.notes: 'Reduce turns required to use cooldown abilities'.

171.notes: 'Boost damage of certain LBs'. lb_ids resolve to limit bursts (173 of 173) and are 0 in 78% of rows, presumably the caster's own LB. opcode_filter lists damage opcodes (e.g. 1&15&102&103&40&72&126).

1001.notes: Monster 'Death Declaration': KO after turn_count turns.

1002.notes: 'Delay effect of Death Declaration for three turns' (params 3,9).

1005.notes: 'Apply caster's boosts to ...'. buff_types is a ';'-separated list, which _decode_param_token does not split on.

1006.notes: 'Use blood abilities twice in one turn' (4 rows).

1007.notes: 'Point-Blank Shot' (2 rows), same layout as 72 but physical damage (attack type 1, 'Damage one enemy').

1011.notes: 'Skip next turn' (value 2); probably counts the cast turn like 100.

1012.notes: 'Take damage based on their status ailments and enfeeblements'. Slot 4 is a ';'-separated list, which _decode_param_token does not split on.

1013.notes: Skills that hit 'chosen enemies'; target_count is 3 in every row, so the player picks up to 3 targets.

1014.notes: skill_id is the owning ability itself in 296 of 306 rows. uses matches '(N uses per battle)'; slot 3 equals slot 2. Pairs with 130.

1015.notes: 'Fill morale gauge'. per_turn 1 = 'every turn' (2 in 75 rows, unconfirmed). Negative amounts on monster skills drain it.

1016.notes: 'Deal morale-based damage'. damage_type 2 = magic (6 of 7 single-effect descriptions); 1 and 3 are likely physical and hybrid.

1017.notes: 'Convert fire damage received to HP restoration': one flag per element.

1018.notes: 'Activate morale-based barrier'. amount and turn_count are read from value ranges; the morale-scaling slots are unnamed.

1019.notes: 'Reduce HP restoration amount for all enemies'.

1020.notes: Slot 0 lists abilities, restore_amount 1-2; likely restores uses or charges of those abilities.

1022.notes: Twelve-param form of 136: skill_ids resolve to abilities; opcode_filter is often 1016 (morale damage). skill_id is the owning ability or a related one.

1023.notes: Twelve-param form of 171: lb_ids resolve to limit bursts (0 in 82% of rows). Descriptions add conditions ('when <unit> is in party', 'at the beginning of battle') that probably sit on the granting passive.

1024.notes: 'Consume evocation gauge to deal morale-based evocation damage'; stat_ratio as in 124.
